# Third-party assets

Sunny Stop uses free and asset-store art for 1.0 (CONCEPT.md §13). **Every
imported asset gets an entry here on the day it is imported, not before
release** — a missing attribution for a CC-BY asset is a takedown risk, and
reconstructing provenance months later is miserable.

## What to record

| Field | Why |
|---|---|
| Asset / pack name | What it is |
| Author | Who to credit |
| Source URL | Where it came from |
| Licence | CC0, CC-BY 4.0, Unity Asset Store EULA, … |
| Attribution required | Yes / no — drives the in-game credits screen |
| Where used | So an asset can be swapped out without archaeology |

## Rules for this project

- **One kit, not many.** Mixing packs is what makes a game look assembled
  rather than designed. Pick a single low-poly kit and stay in it.
- **CC0 preferred.** No attribution obligation, no ambiguity.
- **CC-BY is fine but must appear in the credits screen**, with author and
  licence name, before the build ships.
- **Never import anything without a licence you have actually read.** "Free to
  download" is not a licence.
- Fonts are assets too, and font licences are stricter than most. Check
  embedding rights before shipping one in an app binary.
